summary: Tested Video-Chat feature (video call from chat). All 10 backend API tests pass. Frontend tests pass - video call button visible in chat header, clicking it creates instant meeting and navigates to join page, call message cards display correctly with 'Jetzt beitreten' button.
critical_code_review_comments: Code correctly implements all requested video call from chat features:
- Backend: POST /api/chat/conversations/{conv_id}/call creates instant meeting with status='active' and meeting_type='instant'
- Backend: Meeting has caller as host participant in meeting_participants collection
- Backend: System message 'hat einen Anruf gestartet' created in conversation
- Backend: Call message (type='call') with meeting_id and meeting_code created
- Backend: join_url correctly built using FRONTEND_URL env var
- Frontend: Video call button (data-testid='chat-call-btn') visible in chat header
- Frontend: Clicking call button calls startCall() which navigates to /meetings/{meeting_id}/join
- Frontend: Call message card shows Video icon, 'Videoanruf' title, description, and 'Jetzt beitreten' button
- Frontend: 'Jetzt beitreten' button (data-testid='join-call-{msg_id}') navigates to meeting join page
- Frontend: playCallSound() function creates distinct ring tone (3 tones at 1200Hz/900Hz) for incoming calls
seed_data_creation: Used existing conversations. Created multiple test calls during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Video call from chat feature is fully functional. The call endpoint creates instant meetings and call messages. Frontend correctly displays call cards with join buttons. WebSocket broadcasts call messages to all conversation participants.

backend_api_tests: POST /api/chat/conversations/{conv_id}/call creates meeting and returns meeting_id + join_url ✓
Created meeting exists with status='active' and meeting_type='instant' ✓
System message 'hat einen Anruf gestartet' created in conversation ✓
Meeting has caller as host participant ✓
Multiple calls in same conversation work without errors ✓
Call message has all required fields (message_id, type, meeting_id, meeting_code, etc.) ✓
frontend_tests: Video call button (data-testid='chat-call-btn') visible in chat header ✓
Meeting join page shows correct title 'Anruf: Chat' ✓
Call message cards display with Video icon and 'Videoanruf' title ✓
Call message cards show 'Jetzt beitreten' button (data-testid='join-call-{msg_id}') ✓
'Jetzt beitreten' button navigates to meeting join page ✓
System messages 'hat einen Anruf gestartet' visible between call cards ✓
Video call works in multiple different conversations ✓
